missions.name: Outpost Alpha
missions.briefing: Defend Sentinel-7. Destroy incoming drones before they reach the outpost.
missions.story: The Varkon Empire has crossed the southern border. Sentinel-7 must hold Outpost Alpha while the last civilian convoy escapes.
missions.intel: Scout screens followed by Assault drones. A Heavy leads the final wave.
missions.preparation: Cover split entry lanes; use the primary cannon during reload gaps. Tutorial: aim and hold FIRE; reload with R. Build Machine Guns on slots 1 and 3 and a Cannon on 2. Use bounties for upgrades.
missions.objective: Survive every wave and keep the command bunker operational.
missions.narrative: Outpost Alpha holds. Asteria has time to mobilize.

missions.name: Red Hill Village
missions.briefing: Defend Sentinel-7. Destroy incoming drones before they reach the outpost.
missions.location: Central Asteria / Red Hill agricultural district
missions.story: Outpost Alpha is secure. Varkon drones now hunt supply trucks around Red Hill. Protect the village relay to reopen the northbound evacuation road.
missions.intel: Two approach corridors. Scouts probe both flanks; Assaults and Heavies pressure the later waves.
missions.preparation: Cover split entry lanes; use the primary cannon during reload gaps. Cover both roads early. Use Cannons against armor and Missile splash against groups. The sixth slot protects the western approach.
missions.objective: Survive every wave and keep the command bunker operational.

missions.name: East Supply Depot
missions.briefing: Defend Sentinel-7. Destroy incoming drones before they reach the outpost.
missions.story: Red Hill has restored our supply route. The Empire is converging on the eastern warehouse depot. Hold its power hub so Asterian forces can prepare a counterattack.
missions.intel: Top, west and east entries. Mixed late-wave groups contain multiple Heavies escorted by Assault drones.
missions.preparation: Cover split entry lanes; use the primary cannon during reload gaps. Use all seven slots. Build Cannons on both flanks and Missile coverage near the merge. Save your manual magazine for leaks during Heavy pushes.
missions.objective: Survive every wave and keep the command bunker operational.
